title: drop SP deletes a planned sprint but leaves its research and review stories naming it, so check errors and set --clear sprint refuses
goal: drop of a planned sprint drops its goal research story and its review story with it (or refuses while they exist, naming them), so python3 _tools/backlog.py check prints errors=0 after it; the two items ST-4jmp54ma and ST-7pnsoy42 of the parked SP-kan6spiy were deleted by hand on 2026-10-07 for want of this

run:
import subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
bl = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', '--root', root, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
p = bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'Subject', '--goal', 'goal'); p.check_returncode()
sp = p.stdout.split()[2]
bl('drop', sp, '--why', 'parked').check_returncode()
c = bl('check')
print(c.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
sys.exit(0 if c.returncode == 0 and ' errors=0 ' in c.stdout else 1)

notes: parked link: found by the operator's triage of 2026-10-07 while parking SP-kan6spiy, not by a sprint review; promote only when a sprint needs to drop a planned sprint again. No rule in kb/_self/backlog.md says how a planned sprint is cancelled (a miss of this session: asked as how is a planned sprint cancelled or dropped before it starts).
